title: Allow activation of a checked radio button to clear it
body:
Allow activation of a checked radio button to clear it

Change radio button activation so that activating the checked radio button again returns an optional radio group to its no-selection state.

This addresses optional questions in forms. For example, Chromium issue 40761596 describes an optional gender question whose instructions say not to select an option if none applies. Once a user accidentally selects a radio button, native radio behavior does not provide a way to return to the original no-selection state. The user must instead rely on the page providing a separate clear or reset control, use script, or discard the form.

Radio groups already support a no-selection state: a group can initially have no checked radio button, and script can set a radio button's checkedness to false. This change makes that state reachable through user activation as well.

To preserve author-provided defaults, activating the checked radio button restores the group's checked content attribute default, if one exists, instead of clearing the group. For example, if the markup gives one radio button a `checked` attribute as a safe default, activating the currently checked radio button again returns the group to that default state.

Demo: https://static.januschka.com/i-40761596/index.html
